patch_description: This version crosses the stronger parts of the two best feature families: short-horizon normalized returns, volatility/trend regime change, autocorrelation change, and robust momentum×regime interactions. It keeps the feature count below 80 while emphasizing regime-invariant signals and faster-decaying lookbacks to reduce train→val collapse. The XGBoost setup is slightly more expressive than the current baseline but still regularized to avoid overfitting. I also keep the original interface and output format unchanged.
